source: The final retune, G5a (singular extensions and IIR), the LTC pass, lane A (owner 2026-11-22, DESIGN.md decisions log item 8: G5 split over the two lanes, G5a the extensions and IIR; final-retune-expansion-2026-11-15.md section 3.1's G5 row, class (b) of section 1.2). Tune mode, at LTC on the STC-tuned engine. The tuned commit: the validated candidate c51114974fa190af2ad53614b0ad97ec336c5f6e (branch retune/final-rfp30: every STC group's tuned values, HistoryKeepQuarters 4, LmrMinDepth 3, NullMinDepth 2, RfpMargin 30; bench 3,131,668 / a13b19084ec74fcf), whose defaults ARE the STC pass's values, so no carry: both sides play its defaults outside the group. Starts and bounds: the table's defaults and ranges at the tuned commit (src/tune/params.hpp; none given here, so init reads them at the commit; at c5111497: SingularMinDepth 6 (3-12, 1), SingularEntrySlack 3 (0-6, 1), SingularMarginPerPly 6 (2-16, 1), NoMoveReduceMinDepth 8 (2-16, 1)). c: the STC groups' rule (the screen's, tools/github/spsa-s1-screen.json): spsa_calibrate.py's 2026-11-08 values where a firing counter exists (none of these four has one), else the declared fallback (owner 2026-11-22): 1 unit for a step-1 parameter, 2 table steps otherwise; all four are step 1, so c = 1. Settings (final-retune-expansion-2026-11-15.md section 3.2, owner 2026-11-22): loss_budget 0.5 Elo per group, pair_sd 0.1845 (LTC, the median of 14 LTC SPRTs), iterations max(6, ceil(1.9 p / 1.22)) = 7 for p = 4 (section 5.2's split row: 7 + 8) of 1,664 games (16 shards x 104, 832 pairs), stability_offset 10% of the run's pairs (5,824), alpha 0.602, c fixed, steps clamped to 0.5 c, LTC 40+0.4, Hash 64 (the LTC tests' hash, DESIGN.md section 5.2), Threads 1. Openings: the tuning reserve after the STC groups (spsa-g1a's opening_limit 2,066,400), G5a's then G5b's shares consecutive, each its planned pairs plus 3,328 spare lines (4 abandoned LTC stages of 832), opening_limit its share's last line. No carry.
